column1: # What a winsup build wants, and what this machine was missing.
# Built in the primary Cygwin root, which is where this project's work happens
# and which runs Cygwin 3.6.9 with gcc 14. The RHEL-8.10 emulation cannot do
# this job and that is a finding rather than a preference: it is pinned at
# Cygwin 3.0.7 from a 2019 snapshot on purpose, because RHEL 8.10 ships gcc 8
# and python 3.6 and matching them is the point of that instance. A 2019
# toolchain will not build a 2025 Cygwin, and raising it would defeat the
# instance. The two roots do different jobs.
# Every line below was absent when this spike started and was installed by
# setup-x86_64.exe from the mirror the primary root already uses.
